ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution characterized by a ~95% low-intensity black field punctuated by ~5% high-intensity white/light-grey pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base black pigmentation layer across the entire 2D surface area. Localized high-contrast clusters include linear white streaks on the medial left and right lobes, and circular white constellations localized at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 140 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge. The profile exhibits small peaks and valleys (amplitude 2-5 pixels) with significant structural irregularities and protrusions at the lateral lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex trajectory extending from the medial notch to the lateral tips, with secondary concavity visible near the central hinge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters and ring-like shapes concentrated heavily on the lateral tips (barnacle attachment sites) and sparsely distributed across the central lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive mapping of unaligned linear pixel disruptions; visible white diagonal scratches on the left lobe and vertical rake-like markings on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent epibiotic clusters (barnacles) causing structural deformation of the pixel boundary at the distal lateral edges of both lobes.
